extraction.name: LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal Data
extraction.description: A multimodal benchmark dataset for learning from uncertain data, containing image, audio, and text modalities across 50 classes, with tools for controlled injection of uncertainty and baseline uncertainty quantification models.
extraction.creator: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, Sébastien Foumier
extraction.citeAs: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, and Sébastien Foumier. 2025. LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal Data. In Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR ’25), July 13–18, 2025, Padua, Italy. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 10 pages. https://doi.org/10.1145/3726302.3730302
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was compiled from three modalities collected from multiple sources: images from CIFAR-10/100, audio samples extracted from three audio corpora (The Spoken Wikipedia, LibriSpeech, Mozilla Common Voice) plus 73 volunteered recordings, and text passages generated with Gemma-7B Instruct using prompts based on class labels. Audio samples were automatically validated with Whisper Large V3 and then manually validated for remaining uncertain cases. Text samples were validated by masking label occurrences and reclassifying them with Gemma-7B Instruct.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Experiments, Self-reporting
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 images; audio from The Spoken Wikipedia, LibriSpeech, and Mozilla Common Voice corpora; 73 additional volunteered audio recordings; text generated from class labels using Gemma-7B Instruct.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Images were supplemented with EDM diffusion-generated samples to increase diversity. Audio was extracted from aligned transcripts, validated automatically with Whisper Large V3, and manually checked for false negatives; conflicting manual annotations were rejected. Text was generated with Gemma-7B Instruct using 13 prompts, then regenerated for biased labels with revised prompts to reduce bias. The dataset compilation also supports controlled injection of sample noise, label noise, reduced diversity, and OOD samples.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Audio samples were trimmed/extracted from aligned corpora, automatically transcribed and validated, and extreme noisy or hard-to-interpret samples were filtered out through manual validation. Text samples were masked and reclassified for validation. For baseline modeling, audio was converted to 128x128 mel-spectrograms, text to BERT embeddings, and images used as 32x32 inputs.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Manual validation of audio samples was performed by colleagues using Label Studio with a yes/no question about whether the audio says the target word. Two annotations per sample were collected; samples with conflicting annotations were rejected. Text samples were not manually annotated; they were validated by model-based reclassification after masking label occurrences.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: For audio, 2 annotations per sample were collected from 17 annotators, with 71.61% agreement; only samples confirmed by both annotators were accepted and conflicting annotations were rejected. For text, generated samples were accepted only when Gemma-7B Instruct predicted the original label after masking label occurrences. The paper also reports bias detection using Gemma-7B Instruct, but notes that the accuracy or consistency of these detections could not be assessed.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Colleagues, including M.Sc. and PhD students and professors, with advanced to fluent English knowledge
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: OpenAI Whisper Large V3; Gemma-7B Instruct; Montreal Forced Aligner; audiomentations; nlpaug; BERT; Wav2Vec; VGG-11
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is released as an open-source benchmark with code and instructions on GitHub and as a Hugging Face dataset. The paper states that the dataset can be extended with additional modalities and more data samples, and that the open-source pipeline facilitates community contributions. No explicit versioning, update schedule, or deprecation policy is provided.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Gender-related content appears in generated text for the labels man, woman, boy, and girl; the paper also discusses gender, racial, religious, and cultural bias detection in generated text. No direct collection of personal sensitive attributes from human subjects is described beyond volunteered audio recordings and annotator English proficiency.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to support trustworthy and robust multimodal deep learning and uncertainty quantification for safety-critical applications. The authors note potential social concerns from biased or factually inaccurate LLM-generated text and explicitly state that LUMA should not be used as a source of knowledge or information.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The authors observed offensive biases and stereotypes in generated text, especially strong gender bias for the classes man, woman, boy, and girl. They also note that LLM-generated text may contain factual inaccuracies and biases, and that audio data may include misaligned segments, noisy samples, and strong accents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Text generated by an LLM may contain factual inaccuracies and biases. Audio samples may be misaligned due to forced alignment and may include noisy or hard-to-interpret recordings. The baseline uncertainty methods (MCD and DE) performed poorly for OOD detection on this dataset. The paper states that LUMA shall not be used as a source of knowledge or information.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking, training, testing, validation, fine-tuning, uncertainty quantification, out-of-distribution detection, and robustness evaluation for multimodal learning from uncertain data. The dataset is designed for controlled experiments with varying diversity, sample noise, label noise, and OOD injection.
